applicableAreas: Overhead electric distribution line on southern boundary near proposed mitigation trees
findings.comment: Plant schedule lists tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) but does not indicate utility-compatible (UC) designation per ECM Appendix F. Cannot verify whether proposed trees are UC-designated or not. Applicant must cross-reference all species against ECM Appendix F UC column and confirm all trees within 15 feet of distribution conductor are utility-compatible.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric distribution line on southern boundary
findings.comment: Plant schedule provides species names and minimum container heights (e.g., 16' HT minimum for nursery stock), but does not provide mature height at maturity for any species. Cannot determine which species are large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F maturity classification). Applicant must provide mature height for each tree species and verify no large trees within 25 feet of distribution conductor.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary southeast corner, near OHE utility pole
findings.comment: At least one mitigation tree (M) is positioned 5-8 feet from an existing overhead electric utility pole on the southern boundary, placing it within the prohibited 10-foot clearance zone. All trees must be positioned minimum 10 feet (lateral distance from trunk to pole) from utility poles. Relocate tree or provide documented Austin Energy written approval.

Electrical transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) and trees are shown on landscape plan (Sheet 31), but the landscape plan does not indicate underground electrical equipment locations or dimensioned clearances. Cannot verify that trees are minimum 10 feet from pad-mounted equipment or that no trees are positioned between equipment access doors and drivable surfaces. Applicant must show transformer pad locations on landscape plan with dimensioned clearances from proposed trees.

applicableAreas: Pull box and underground electrical equipment locations
findings.comment: Electrical pull boxes are shown on electrical plan but not indicated on landscape plan with distances to proposed trees. Cannot verify that trees are minimum 5 feet from underground electrical equipment. Applicant must show pull box and underground equipment locations on landscape plan with dimensioned clearances from all proposed trees.

applicableAreas: Areas within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment
findings.comment: Without documented locations and distances of underground electrical equipment relative to proposed trees, cannot verify root barrier requirements for trees within 20 feet of underground equipment. Root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) must be detailed for any trees within 20 feet. Applicant must identify trees within 20 feet of underground equipment and specify root barrier details on landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan tree symbols throughout site
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows tree locations using symbol designations (M, SY, PL, P) without species identification. Plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists species and quantities separately but does not cross-reference which species correspond to each symbol on the landscape plan. Reviewers cannot verify species identity, utility compatibility, or maturity height for specific tree locations. Applicant must either label trees on landscape plan with species names or add legend clearly linking each landscape symbol to specific species in plant schedule.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan where large trees (40+ feet) may be proposed near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not differentiate large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Plant schedule provides species names but no mature height values. Cannot determine which, if any, proposed species mature to 40+ feet or whether such trees are positioned outside the 25-foot clearance zone from distribution conductors. Applicant must provide mature height for each tree species and use notation or symbol on landscape plan to identify all trees that mature to 40+ feet.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary southeast corner, mitigation tree within 10 feet of OHE pole
findings.comment: At least one tree is proposed within a prohibited clearance zone (less than 10 feet from utility pole), which violates the categorical prohibition for all tree types. Plans do not include documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing this exception. Applicant must either relocate the tree to comply with minimum 10-foot clearance or provide executed written approval letter from Austin Energy explicitly authorizing the variance.
